releaseNotes:
1. Section-Wise Feeder Hierarchy & Display Color Management: Added three-level GIS hierarchy (Imported Files -> Line Sections -> Feeders) with + New Section, + New Feeder, and dedicated feeder display color system.
2. Marker & Polyline Coloring: Tower markers and line polylines render in assigned feeder colors with high-contrast outlines and casing; interactive floating map legend.
3. Feeder Options Menu Polishing: Removed redundant 'Rename File (Parent Project)' menu entry; retained Rename Feeder, Change Color, Duplicate, and Move to Section.
4. UI Refinements: Splash screen delay updated to 1.5s; Help author updated to Er. D. Sakthivel; high-contrast cyan/teal text cursors across all input fields; centered compact active feeder indicator.
5. Universal Multi-ABI Support: Bundled native binaries for armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a, x86, and x86_64 for zero-crash stability on all devices and emulators.

previousStableRelease.releaseNotes:
1. Three-Level GIS Data Hierarchy: Upgraded architecture to 'Imported Files → Line Sections → Feeders'. Independent Line Section creation (+ New Section) with SQLite persistence, duplicate protection, and section management.
2. Feeder-Specific Display Colors: Unique display color assigned per feeder applied across tower markers, polylines (with high-contrast casing), right drawer indicator dot, and map legend.
3. Section & Feeder View/Hide: Toggling Section eye icon bulk-toggles all child feeders while preserving stored individual visibility; summary color dots in drawer.
4. Universal Multi-ABI Support: Bundled native binaries for armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a, x86, and x86_64.
